intent: Promotional README header concept art; not a gameplay screenshot
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: inspiring cinematic header artwork for the public GitHub README of the playable Star Wars fan game Rebel Watch.
Primary request: an exceptionally crafted panoramic game key-art banner, 3:1 wide composition, premium blocky/HD voxel 3D forms with physically believable wet materials. This is promotional concept art.
Scene/backdrop: a lived-in ochre stone frontier spaceport immediately after rain, warm lanterns reflected in dark slate paving, industrial vents, aerials, patched rust-red canvas, ancient walls, rooftop landing pads and distant angular mountains. An original wedge-nosed white and weathered red shuttle rises from a rooftop, twin blue engine glow. The city opens toward a luminous sunrise after a storm, hopeful and mythic.
Subject: at the lower center-right foreground, a small original helmeted traveler in gunmetal armor and a weathered ochre flight cloak stands with their loyal knee-high boxy four-legged scout droid, cream-and-bronze panels, broad single amber optic, four sturdy square feet. Both face the city and dawn. Keep the droid distinctly small, like a warm lantern beside a traveler. Their silhouettes feel like the rebellion keeping hope alive in an occupied world.
Composition/framing: sweeping wide horizon, foreground figures and city below; restrained cinematic negative space in upper-left/center for excellent legible title typography. Render the environment with lovingly detailed blocky architecture, not a photoreal live-action film frame.
Lighting/mood: cool cyan storm shadows against warm gold sunrise and amber lanterns, misty depth, wet reflections, hopeful, sad but beautiful. Rich controlled contrast and readable silhouettes.
Text (verbatim): large elegant widely tracked cream capitals "REBEL WATCH", with smaller uppercase subtitle "THE EMBER OUTPOST" and tiny final line "HOPE KEEPS WATCH."
Constraints: title should feel like a premium space-opera game, no existing franchise logo, no watermark, no unrelated labels, no HUD, no fake game screenshot. Original traveler and droid, coherent polished art.
